equity.title: Karachi schedule hours by IBC
equity.intro: How K-Electric's published load-shed schedule is spread across its IBC areas, with census indicators for the sub-divisions that share an IBC's name. Descriptive only: these figures do not show why a feeder has its schedule.
equity.shareTitle: Share of scheduled feeders at 12 hours, by IBC
equity.shareIntro: Among listed feeders with a schedule row. n = scheduled feeders in the IBC. Areas with fewer than {min} scheduled feeders are marked: their shares move a lot with one feeder.
equity.subTitle: Census sub-divisions with a same-named IBC
equity.subIntro: {ibcs} IBC areas were matched by name to {subs} census sub-divisions. Boundaries were not compared, so an IBC and its sub-division may not cover the same area. Sindh publishes household size rounded to whole numbers.
equity.corrIntro: Spearman rank correlation runs from -1 to 1. These are exploratory descriptions: no significance test, no causal reading, and with n = {n} sub-divisions a single area can change the value a lot.
equity.anomIntro: Counts of feeders that fall under each rule. They describe the published data, not errors by anyone.
equity.engineTemplate: Generated from a fixed template. Every number comes from a named warehouse query.
equity.engineLlm: Prose drafted by a language model ({engine}). Every number was inserted from a named warehouse query and checked; drafts with any other number or with causal wording are rejected.

about.title: About the data
about.what: Roshni shows the load-shedding schedules that IESCO and K-Electric publish, and the planned shutdowns IESCO announces in press releases. These are plans, not measurements: a feeder listed as scheduled may have had power, and a feeder not listed may not have.
about.levels: IESCO publishes a playbook: one schedule for each interruption level (2 to 12 hours a day). Its files never say which level is in force, so this site never assumes one. You choose the level.
about.time: All times are Pakistan Standard Time (Asia/Karachi, UTC+5, no daylight saving). A window such as 22:35–02:05 crosses midnight; the end minute is not included.
about.matching: Feeders are matched to census localities and press-release names by name only. A match's percentage is the name similarity after ignoring case, spacing and punctuation; 100% means identical names, which are accepted automatically. Other matches are decided by written rules, then by a language model choosing only among listed candidates, then by Claude; each shows its confidence, who accepted it and why. Unmatched names are shown as printed.
about.datesNote: When a file states no date, its effective date is when the server says the file last changed. That can differ from the label on the source page: IESCO labels its schedule files {label}, but the files were last changed on {date}, so the schedule may have applied since then.
about.pressBasis: The shutdown dates printed in each release

match.similarity: {pct}% is the name similarity between “{printed}” and “{matched}”, after ignoring case, spacing and punctuation (100% = identical names).
match.exactInfo: The names are identical after ignoring case, spacing and punctuation, so the match was accepted automatically.
